summary.zh: 图片浏览器与关注功能大修：捏合缩放、全文档图片滑动浏览、组织账号识别、关注数据匿名回退与权限明确提示；构建产物下载后保持展开。
summary.en: Image viewer and follow overhaul: pinch zoom, swipe through every image in a document, organization badges, anonymous fallback for org-restricted follow data, explicit permission hints, and artifacts stay expanded after download.

items.zh: 图片浏览器：任意时刻支持双指捏合缩放（无需先双击），放大后拖到边缘可翻到上/下一张，图片平移有边界；双击与单击行为不变。
items.en: Image viewer: pinch zoom now works from 1x (no double-tap needed), dragging past an edge while zoomed flips to the previous/next image, and panning is clamped to the image bounds.

items.zh: 图片浏览：issue、PR、评论、发布说明、文件查看里的所有图片自动组成图库，点开任意一张即可左右滑动浏览整篇文档的图片（此前仅 README 支持）。
items.en: Image gallery: all images in issues, PRs, comments, release notes, and file views now form a swipeable gallery — previously only READMEs did.

items.zh: 组织账号识别：个人主页显示组织徽章，组织页隐藏永远为空的关注中统计；关注者列表与关注操作对组织均有效。
items.en: Organization accounts: a badge on the profile header, the permanently-empty following stat is hidden on org pages, and followers/follow work for orgs.

items.zh: 关注数据修复：组织限制第三方应用时关注者/关注中列表改用匿名请求回退，不再误显示为空；关注状态检查同样回退。
items.en: Follow data: when an organization restricts OAuth apps, the followers/following lists and the follow-state check now fall back to anonymous requests instead of reading as empty.

items.zh: 权限提示：关注失败(404)区分凭证缺权限（提示重新登录）与组织限制（提示浏览器操作）；列表加载失败区分权限拒绝与网络问题并给出对应指引。
items.en: Permission hints: follow 404s distinguish a token missing user:follow (re-login hint) from org restrictions (browser hint); list failures distinguish permission denial from network errors with matching guidance.

items.zh: 我的页面：关注者/关注中统计按钮改为本页底部弹窗（与个人主页弹窗同款），不再跳转页面。
items.en: Profile tab: the followers/following stat buttons open the same bottom sheet as the user-detail page in place, instead of navigating away.

items.zh: 构建产物：下载并解压完成后产物卡片自动展开并保持展开，收起仍可手动操作。
items.en: Artifacts: the artifact card auto-expands and stays expanded once its files are downloaded and extracted; collapsing remains manual.

items.zh: 文本选择与页签指示器修复：分页滑动时清除选区、浮动复制工具栏跟随位置、选区在翻页间保持。
items.en: Selection and tab indicator fixes: selection clears when swiping pages, the floating copy toolbar tracks its anchor, and pager tabs interpolate continuously.
